core_purpose_after_pivot: Establish a licensed, auditable real-GT benchmark for single-image/few-view head reconstruction before making any reconstruction-quality claim.
benchmark_acceptance_criteria: camera intrinsics and extrinsics for every selected view
foreground masks or reliable segmentation route
GT full-head mesh or point cloud
license/privacy status allows compact derived audit artifacts in repo
model/data distribution audit recorded before interpreting results
